title: Door not closed
causes: The door is not shut fully.
Laundry is caught between the door and the seal.
steps: Open the door and check the rubber seal for trapped clothes.
Close the door firmly until it clicks.
Start the programme again.
technician: If the code stays with the door firmly closed, the door lock may be faulty. Book a Bosch service visit.

title: Water took too long to fill
causes: The water tap is closed or only partly open.
The inlet hose is kinked.
Low water pressure in the home.
steps: Check that the tap feeding the machine is fully open.
Make sure the inlet hose is not bent or squashed.
Restart the programme.
technician: If the tap is open and the code returns, call Bosch service. The inlet valve or AquaStop hose may need checking.

title: Water not draining
causes: The drain pump or pump filter is blocked.
The drain hose is kinked or blocked.
Small objects (coins, buttons) are stuck in the pump.
steps: Switch off the machine, unplug it and close the water tap.
Let hot water cool before you start.
Put a flat container and towels under the pump flap, drain the water with the emergency drain hose, then clean the pump filter.
Check the drain hose for kinks or blockages and straighten it.
Refit the filter firmly, plug in and run a drain or spin programme.
technician: If it still will not drain after cleaning the filter and hose, the drain pump is probably faulty. Call a technician.

title: Water took too long to heat
causes: The machine did not reach the set wash temperature in the allowed time.
Usually a fault in the heating system.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again, then restart the programme.
technician: Bosch says this fault cannot be fixed by the user. Book a service visit if it returns.

title: Heating switched on when it should not
causes: The machine detected heating at an unexpected time.
An electronic or heating control fault.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine for a short time.
Plug in again and restart the programme.
technician: If the code comes back, stop using the machine and call Bosch service.

title: AquaStop leak protection triggered
causes: Water has collected in the base of the machine.
A leak inside the machine or from the AquaStop hose.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
Close the water tap.
Wipe up any water on the floor.
technician: Bosch says this cannot be fixed by the user. Keep the tap closed and book a service visit.

title: Turbidity (water clarity) sensor fault
causes: The sensor that checks how dirty the water is has a problem.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again and restart the programme.
technician: If the code returns, call Bosch service to check the sensor.

title: Water level (pressure) sensor fault
causes: The analogue pressure sensor that measures the water level in the drum is faulty.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again and restart the programme.
technician: Bosch says this fault needs a service visit.

title: Pressure sensor fault
causes: The pressure sensor is not working correctly.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again and restart the programme.
technician: If the code returns, call Bosch service.

title: Water flow sensor fault
causes: The sensor that measures incoming water is reporting a problem.
steps: Check that the water tap is fully open.
Switch the machine off and on again and restart the programme.
technician: If the code returns, call Bosch service.

title: No water coming in
causes: The water tap is closed.
The inlet hose is blocked, kinked or frozen.
Water pressure is too low.
Hot and cold hoses are connected to the wrong taps.
The mesh filter at the hose inlet is dirty.
steps: Open the water tap fully.
Check the inlet hose for kinks, blockages or ice.
Check that hot and cold hoses go to the right taps.
Close the tap, unscrew the hose and clean the small mesh filter, then refit it.
Wait 3 minutes (buttons are locked after this code), then restart.
technician: If water still does not come in with the tap open and a clean filter, contact Samsung service.

title: Water supply too hot
causes: The cold inlet hose is connected to a hot water tap, or not firmly attached to the cold tap.
steps: Make sure the cold hose is firmly connected to the cold tap.
Turn the machine off and on again and restart.
technician: If the code continues with correct connections, contact Samsung service.

title: Water not draining
causes: The drain hose is blocked, kinked or frozen.
The drain hose is set up wrongly.
The debris filter is clogged.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
Check the drain hose is straight and not blocked or frozen.
Put towels and a shallow tray down, then drain the water and clean the debris filter at the front.
Refit the filter firmly, plug in and try a drain or spin.
technician: If it still will not drain, the drain pump may be faulty. Contact Samsung service.

title: Door open or not closed properly
causes: The machine was started with the door open.
Laundry is caught in the door.
steps: Open the door and remove any clothes trapped in the seal.
Close the door firmly and restart.
technician: If the code stays with the door closed, the door lock may be faulty. Contact Samsung service.

title: Door lock not locking or unlocking
causes: The main door lock is not working as expected.
steps: Turn the machine off, wait a moment and turn it back on.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If it keeps happening, the door lock needs a service check.

title: Too much water (overflow)
causes: The machine detected a water level that is too high.
steps: Let the machine finish draining and spinning.
Restart the cycle after the spin has ended.
Use the right amount of detergent to avoid too much foam.
technician: If the code returns on every wash, contact Samsung service. The water valve or level sensor may be faulty.

title: Unbalanced load, cannot spin
causes: Laundry is bunched to one side of the drum.
Only one heavy item is in the drum.
The machine is not level or stable.
steps: Pause the machine and spread the laundry evenly.
Add a few more items if washing only one heavy item.
Make sure the machine stands level on a firm floor.
Restart the spin.
technician: If it happens with normal, even loads, the machine may need a check for worn parts.

title: Drain hose problem / leak detected
causes: The end of the drain hose is lying on the floor.
The drain hose is clogged.
steps: Switch off the machine.
Make sure the drain hose end is raised and not on the floor.
Check the hose for blockages.
Wipe up any water and restart.
technician: If water keeps leaking or the code returns, contact Samsung service.

title: Drum motor problem
causes: The motor is not running as expected.
steps: Switch off the machine, wait a minute and switch it back on.
Check the load is not too big, then restart the cycle.
technician: If the code returns, the motor or its control needs a service check.

title: Communication fault between circuit boards
causes: The main and sub control boards are not talking to each other.
steps: Turn the machine off, then on again.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code keeps returning, contact Samsung service.

title: Heating system fault (too hot)
causes: The machine detected a high-temperature heating problem.
steps: Turn the machine off and on again.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code returns, stop using hot programmes and contact Samsung service.

title: Water level sensor fault
causes: The sensor that measures water level is not working correctly.
steps: Turn the machine off and on again.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code returns, contact Samsung service.

title: Power supply problem (voltage too low or unstable)
causes: Low or unstable mains voltage.
A short power cut.
Loose plug or extension lead.
steps: Check the plug is pushed firmly into the wall socket.
Avoid extension leads and adapters.
Wait for power to settle, then restart.
technician: If it happens often, ask an electrician to check the supply. Contact Samsung service if the supply is fine.

title: Vibration sensor fault
causes: The sensor that detects imbalance is not working correctly.
steps: Turn the machine off and on again.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code returns, contact Samsung service.

title: Add Door opened without restarting
causes: The small Add Door (AddWash) was opened and the machine is waiting.
steps: Close the Add Door properly.
Press and hold Start/Pause to continue.
technician: Not normally needed. If the Add Door will not stay closed, contact Samsung service.

title: Water not draining
causes: The drain hose is kinked or blocked.
The drain pump filter is clogged.
Too much foam from too much detergent.
steps: Check the drain hose behind the machine and straighten any kinks.
Run a spin-only cycle and listen for the pump humming.
Unplug the washer. Put a container under the drain pump cover, drain the water with the small drain tube, then clean the pump filter.
Close the drain tube cap tightly and refit the filter.
Use less detergent next time and run Tub Clean.
technician: If the code returns after cleaning the filter and hose, request LG service. The pump may be faulty.

title: Water not filling in time
causes: The tap is closed or water is off.
The inlet hose is kinked or disconnected.
The inlet filter is blocked.
Frozen pipes or hoses in cold weather.
steps: Make sure the tap is fully open and the hose is connected.
Straighten any kinked or squashed hose.
Close the tap, remove the hose and clean the inlet filter, then refit.
In freezing weather, thaw the tap and hose with warm (not boiling) water.
technician: If water still does not flow, the inlet valve may be faulty. Request service.

title: Unbalanced load
causes: Laundry has bunched to one side.
Load too big or too small.
Bulky or waterproof items.
The washer is not level.
steps: Pause the washer and spread the laundry evenly.
Fill the drum about two-thirds full.
Wash bulky items like duvets on the right programme with medium spin.
Level the washer by adjusting the feet.
technician: If it happens with normal, even loads on a level floor, request service.

title: Motor locked, drum will not turn
causes: The washer is overloaded.
A coin or small object is jamming the drum.
steps: Unplug the washer and wait 5 minutes.
Remove some laundry to reduce the load.
With the power off, check the drum for coins or small objects and remove them.
Plug in and try again.
technician: If LE keeps showing, unplug the washer and contact LG service.

title: Door not closed
causes: Laundry is caught between the door and the seal.
The door is not fully shut.
steps: Open the door, free any trapped clothes and close it firmly.
Reset: unplug the washer, hold Start/Pause for 5 seconds, plug in again and retry.
technician: If the code continues, request LG service.

title: Door closed but not locked
causes: The drum is overloaded.
Something is caught in the door seal.
The door latch is bent or broken.
steps: Remove anything blocking the door and reduce the load if needed.
Open and close the door again.
Reset the washer by unplugging it for a short time.
technician: If the lock still will not engage, the door latch or lock needs repair. Request service.

title: Motor over-current
causes: Too much current in the motor circuit, for example from a short circuit, loose connection or power surge.
steps: Unplug the washer for 10 seconds.
Plug it back in and run a cycle.
technician: If CE returns, close the tap, unplug the washer and arrange a repair.

title: Too much water (overfill)
causes: Extra water is entering, for example through the detergent drawer.
steps: Check if water is running through the detergent drawer.
Unplug the washer for 60 seconds and restart.
Run a short programme and see if it drains.
technician: If FE continues, the water valve or sensor needs checking. Request service.

title: Water level sensor fault
causes: The water level sensor is not working properly.
steps: Unplug the washer for 10 seconds.
Plug it back in and restart the cycle.
technician: If PE returns, arrange a repair.

title: Leak detected inside the washer
causes: Water leaking inside the machine.
A damaged or loose inlet hose.
A faulty leak safety switch.
steps: Check the inlet hose for cuts or loose connections.
Unplug the washer for 60 seconds and restart.
technician: If AE continues, close the tap and book a service visit.

title: Heating / temperature sensor error
causes: Usually a faulty temperature sensor (thermistor).
steps: Unplug the washer for 10 seconds, then plug it back in.
Select no spin to drain the water, then restart the cycle.
technician: If tE returns, close the taps, unplug the washer and arrange service.

title: Too much foam
causes: Too much detergent.
Using non-HE or the wrong type of detergent.
steps: Let the washer finish its foam-reducing routine.
Use less detergent next time, and only high-efficiency (HE) detergent.
Put powder or pods where the manual says, not in the liquid cup.
technician: Not usually needed. If it shows with very little detergent, request service.

title: Power failure during a cycle
causes: The power was cut while the washer was running.
steps: Unplug the washer or switch off its circuit breaker.
Hold Start/Pause for 5 seconds while it is unplugged.
Restore power and run a cycle.
technician: If PF keeps appearing without power cuts, arrange a repair.

title: Frozen water in the washer
causes: The temperature inside dropped below freezing and water in the hoses or tub froze.
steps: Remove the laundry.
Pour warm water (around 50–60°C, never boiling) into the drum and wait 1–2 hours.
Drain the water through the drain tube and recap it.
Thaw frozen inlet hoses in warm water, then refit them and run a rinse.
technician: If FF shows when it is not cold, request service.

title: Door not locked
causes: Laundry is caught in the door.
The door is not closed properly.
steps: Open the door and close it again firmly.
If needed, remove a few items and push the door shut.
Press Start again, or switch off and on and restart.
technician: If the door will not lock, call Siemens service.

title: Water took too long to fill
causes: Low water pressure.
A blocked filter in the supply hose.
A blocked AquaStop hose.
steps: Check the tap is fully open.
Check the flow: a fully open tap should fill about 10 litres per minute.
Close the tap and clean the filter in the supply hose.
Make sure the hose is not kinked.
technician: If pressure is too low, call a plumber. If the supply is fine, call Siemens service.

title: Water not draining
causes: The pump filter is blocked.
The drain hose is blocked or kinked.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine. Let hot water cool.
Place towels and a flat container under the filter flap and drain the water.
Clean the pump filter and refit it firmly.
Straighten the drain hose and check for blockages.
technician: If it still will not drain, call Siemens service.

title: Water took too long to heat
causes: A fault in the heating system.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again and restart.
technician: Siemens says the user cannot fix this. Book a service visit.

title: Unexpected heating
causes: Heating was detected when it should be off.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again.
technician: If it persists, book a Siemens service visit.

title: Leak – water in the base
causes: The machine is leaking, or water has collected in the base plate.
steps: Turn off the water tap straight away.
Switch off and unplug the machine.
Wipe up water from the floor.
technician: Call Siemens service to find and fix the leak.

title: Turbidity sensor fault
causes: The water clarity sensor is faulty.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again.
technician: Book a Siemens service visit.

title: Water level sensor fault
causes: The analogue pressure sensor is faulty.
steps: Switch the machine off and on again.
technician: Book a Siemens service visit.

title: Water inlet problem
causes: Low water pressure or a blocked supply filter or AquaStop hose.
steps: Check the tap is fully open and the flow is about 10 litres per minute.
Close the tap and clean the filter in the supply hose.
Make sure the hose is not kinked.
technician: If the supply is fine and the code returns, call Siemens service.

title: Unbalanced load – spin stopped
causes: Laundry is unevenly spread in the drum. This is not a fault.
steps: Spread large and small items evenly in the drum.
Run the spin again.
technician: Not needed unless it happens with every normal load.

title: Too much foam
causes: Too much detergent, especially with soft water or lightly soiled laundry.
steps: Use less detergent next time.
Run a rinse to clear the foam.
technician: Not usually needed.

title: Door not locked
causes: The door is not closed fully, often because of a very full drum.
An item is stuck between the door and the body.
steps: Check for clothes caught in the door.
Close the door until it clicks.
Restart the programme.
technician: If the door still will not lock, call Siemens service.

title: Water supply problem
causes: Water supply is restricted or cut off, for example a closed tap or kinked hose.
steps: Check the water tap is fully open.
Make sure the inlet hose is not kinked or squashed.
Reset: switch off at the socket for about one minute, then on again and restart.
technician: If the code returns straight away, or the machine still will not fill, book a repair.

title: Draining problem
causes: Blocked drain pump filter or drain hose.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine. Let hot water cool.
Drain the water into a container and clean the drain pump filter.
Check the drain hose is not kinked or blocked.
Plug in and run a drain or spin.
technician: If water still will not drain, book a repair.

title: Water pressure (level) sensor problem
causes: The sensor that measures the water level has a fault, or too much foam affects the reading.
steps: Switch off at the socket for about one minute, then on again.
Use the correct amount of detergent.
technician: If the code returns, book a repair.

title: Door lock problem
causes: The door is not closed properly, or the door lock has a fault.
steps: Open the door, check nothing is caught in the seal, and close it firmly.
Switch off at the socket for about one minute, then restart.
technician: If the door still will not lock, book a repair.

title: Motor problem
causes: A fault in the motor or drive system.
steps: Switch off at the socket for about one minute, then restart.
technician: If the drum still will not turn, book a repair.

title: Heating problem
causes: A fault in the heater or temperature sensor.
steps: Switch off at the socket for about one minute, then restart.
technician: If the code returns, book a repair.

title: Warning: leak, too much foam or unbalanced load
causes: Water leaking inside the machine.
Too much detergent foam.
An unbalanced load.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine and check for water on the floor.
If there is no leak, use less detergent and spread the load evenly.
Restart after the foam has settled.
technician: If you see a leak or the code keeps coming back, close the tap and book a repair.

title: Power supply problem
causes: The mains voltage is irregular or unstable.
steps: Plug the machine straight into a wall socket, without extension leads.
Switch off for about one minute, then on again.
technician: If it keeps happening, ask an electrician to check the supply.

title: Electronic circuit board fault
causes: A fault on the control board. Some or all functions do not work.
steps: Unplug the machine for at least 2 minutes.
Plug in, wait 30 seconds and try again.
technician: If the fault remains, book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Motor circuit fault
causes: A fault in the motor circuit. The drum turns on and off or not at all.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Temperature sensor fault
causes: The temperature sensing circuit is faulty, so the machine does not heat.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Drain blocked or pump problem
causes: A blocked pump filter, waste hose or under-sink plumbing.
A failed drain pump.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine. Let hot water cool.
If your model has a pump filter, drain the water into a container and clean the filter.
Check the waste hose and the under-sink pipe for blockages.
Plug in and try a drain or spin.
technician: If it still will not drain, the pump has probably failed. Book an engineer.

title: Door lock fault
causes: The door lock is blocked or faulty.
steps: Check the door and lock area for anything in the way.
Close the door firmly and restart.
Check Hotpoint's safety notice page – some door locks are under recall.
technician: If the fault persists, book an engineer.

title: Heating circuit / board fault
causes: A fault in the heating circuit or control board. The wash pauses and the pump may keep running.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Heater fault
causes: The heater is faulty, so the programme pauses mid-wash.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Software fault
causes: A software problem. Lights flash and no programme can be chosen.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Drain pump circuit fault
causes: A fault in the pump circuit. Water stays in the drum.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
Do not open the door while there is water in the drum.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Electronic control fault
causes: A fault in the controls. The machine will not switch on.
steps: Check the plug and socket work with another appliance.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Heater control fault
causes: A heater control fault. Water does not heat or the wash pauses.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Internal data error
causes: An internal data problem. Some or all display functions do not work.
steps: Unplug the machine for at least 2 minutes.
Plug in, wait 30 seconds and try again.
technician: If it remains, book a Hotpoint engineer.

title: Electronic circuit board fault
causes: A control board fault. Some or all functions cannot be selected.
steps: Unplug the machine for at least 2 minutes.
Plug in, wait 30 seconds and try again.
technician: If the fault remains, book an Indesit engineer.

title: Motor circuit fault
causes: A fault in the motor circuit. The drum turns on and off or not at all.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Temperature sensor fault
causes: The temperature sensing circuit is faulty, so the machine does not heat.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Drain blocked or pump problem
causes: A blocked pump filter, waste hose or under-sink plumbing.
A failed drain pump.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine. Let hot water cool.
If your model has a pump filter, drain the water into a container and clean it.
Check the waste hose and under-sink pipe for blockages.
Plug in and try a drain or spin.
technician: If it still will not drain, the pump has probably failed. Book an engineer.

title: Door lock fault
causes: The door lock is blocked or faulty.
steps: Check the door and lock area for anything in the way.
Close the door firmly and restart.
Check the brand's safety notice – some door locks are under recall.
technician: If the fault persists, book an engineer.

title: Heating circuit / board fault
causes: A heating circuit or control board fault. The wash pauses and the pump may keep running.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Heater fault
causes: The heater is faulty, so the programme pauses mid-wash.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Software fault
causes: A software problem. Lights flash and no programme can be chosen.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Drain pump circuit fault
causes: A fault in the pump circuit. Water stays in the drum.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
Do not open the door while there is water in the drum.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Electronic control fault
causes: A fault in the controls. The machine will not switch on.
steps: Check the plug and socket work with another appliance.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Heater control fault
causes: A heater control fault. Water does not heat or the wash pauses.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine.
technician: Book an Indesit engineer.

title: Internal data error
causes: An internal data problem. Some or all display functions do not work.
steps: Unplug the machine for at least 2 minutes.
Plug in, wait 30 seconds and try again.
technician: If it remains, book an Indesit engineer.

title: Pump filter may be clogged (drain problem)
causes: The pump filter is blocked, so water cannot drain.
steps: Switch off and unplug the machine. Let hot water cool.
Drain the remaining water into a container and clean the pump filter.
Refit the filter firmly and run a spin cycle.
technician: If the problem continues, call Beko service.

title: No water coming in
causes: The tap is closed or there is a water cut.
The inlet hose is folded or loose.
The front filter cover is not closed and locked.
steps: Turn the tap on and check there is mains water.
Check the inlet hose connection and straighten any folds.
Make sure the front cover is closed and locked.
Run the machine again.
technician: If the problem continues, call Beko service.

title: Water may be inside the machine (leak)
causes: Water has collected inside the machine, possibly from a leak.
steps: Unplug the machine.
Wipe up any water under the machine.
Plug in and run a short cycle while you watch it.
technician: If water leaks from a hose or the code returns, close the taps and call Beko service.

title: Too much foam
causes: Too much detergent for the load.
Detergent put in the wrong compartment or stored badly.
steps: Match the detergent dose to the load size and how dirty it is.
Use less detergent for very absorbent fabrics.
Run the Drum Cleaning programme (or Cotton 90°C) with an empty drum.
technician: If the problem continues, call Beko service.

title: Unbalanced load – spin did not start
causes: Too little laundry, or laundry bunched to one side.
steps: Add more items if the load is very small.
Spread the laundry evenly by hand.
Run the spin again.
technician: Not usually needed.

title: Draining problem
causes: The drain hose is not connected correctly.
steps: Check the drain hose connection to the drain.
Make sure the hose is not kinked or blocked.
technician: If the problem continues, call Beko service.

title: Self-protection mode (supply problem)
causes: A problem with the mains voltage or water pressure.
steps: Cancel the programme by turning the programme knob to another programme.
Start the programme again.
technician: If the problem continues, call Beko service.

title: Water inlet blocked or restricted
causes: The stopcock (tap) is closed.
The inlet filter is dirty.
The inlet hose is kinked.
Water pressure is too low.
steps: Stop the programme and open the tap fully.
Close the tap, unscrew the inlet hose, take out the small filter, clean it and put it back.
Refit the hose, open the tap and check for drips.
Straighten any kinks in the hose.
Check flow: at least 5 litres should run out in 15 seconds.
technician: If pressure is too low, call a plumber. If the hose is damaged, Miele service can replace it.

title: Drain restricted
causes: The drain hose end is higher than 1 metre.
The drain hose is kinked.
The drain filter or pump is blocked by objects like buttons or coins.
steps: Switch off the machine. Let hot water cool to avoid scalding.
Lower the drain hose end to 1 metre or less and remove kinks.
Open the drain pump flap, place a container underneath and slowly unscrew the drain filter to release the water.
Clean the filter, check the pump impeller turns freely, then screw the filter back tightly.
technician: If the fault persists, contact Miele service.

title: Hot water inlet blocked or restricted
causes: The hot water tap is not fully open.
The hot water inlet filter is dirty.
Hot water pressure is too low.
steps: Open the hot water tap fully and restart.
Close the tap, unscrew the hot water hose, clean the small filter and refit it.
Check flow: at least 5 litres in 15 seconds.
technician: If pressure is too low and cannot be raised, contact a plumber or Miele service.

title: Heating fault
causes: The set temperature was not reached in time (Thermostop).
A technical fault in the heating system.
steps: Switch off at the wall and unplug, or switch off the fuse.
Wait at least 2 minutes.
Reconnect, switch on and restart the programme.
technician: If F20 returns, contact Miele service.

title: Door could not be locked
causes: The drum is overloaded.
A technical fault in the lock.
steps: Take some laundry out so the load is within the limit.
Switch off and on again.
If needed, unplug for at least 2 minutes, then reconnect and switch on.
technician: If the fault returns, contact Miele service.

title: Door could not be unlocked
causes: A technical fault in the door lock.
steps: Switch off at the wall and unplug, or switch off the fuse.
Wait at least 2 minutes, then reconnect and switch on.
technician: If the door still will not open, contact Miele service. Do not force the door.

title: Leak protection triggered
causes: Water has been detected inside the machine because of a leak.
steps: Unplug the machine.
Close the water tap.
Wipe up water on the floor.
Do not use the machine until it is repaired.
technician: Miele says the leak must be repaired by Miele service. Do not try to fix it yourself.
